shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore && echo --- && ls /workspace/__agent_eval__ && echo --- && ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50

set -e
echo "-- add book 1 --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Project Hail Mary&author=Andy Weir&notes=so far so good' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' | head -5
echo "-- add book 2 --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' | head -5
echo "-- home page --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'book-title|book-author|Currently reading|Finished'
echo "-- data file --"
cat /workspace/data/books.json

ID=53e86557-6d8e-4a35-9a5c-e773b9b53a06
echo "-- detail page --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E 'Project Hail Mary|Andy Weir|so far so good|Currently reading|share'
echo "-- mark finished --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish | head -3
echo "-- detail after finish --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E 'Finished|Mark finished'
echo "-- update notes --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/notes -d 'notes=Loved the ending!' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' | head -3
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E 'Loved the ending'
echo "-- 404 --"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/books/does-not-exist
echo "-- home reflects finished --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'book-title|badge'

kill %1 2>/dev/null
echo '[]' > /workspace/data/books.json
rm -f /workspace/data/books.json  # let the app recreate it fresh on first request
git -C /workspace status --short
